title: GPT Image keeps transparent backgrounds
summary:
GPT Image gained transparent PNGs and less duplicated generation, while ad preferences became editable and image safety checks expanded.

GPT Image now returns PNGs without the usual JPEG conversion, preserving transparent backgrounds. Identical image requests made at the same time also share one generation instead of starting duplicates; failed generations can be retried.

Authenticated users can now view and change their ad preference with a Show Ads toggle. Existing explicit choices are preserved, while previously unset preferences default to on. The site also dropped its YouTube social link and an unused video component.

GPT Image prompt moderation now uses Azure Content Safety, and image-editing requests also check fetched input images. The checks block content rated medium or high severity across hate, self-harm, sexual content, and violence.

highlights.title: Transparent GPT Image output
highlights.text: Generate PNGs with transparent backgrounds using `gptimage`, without the usual JPEG conversion flattening them. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).

highlights.title: Choose whether to show ads
highlights.text: Authenticated users can now view and change their ad preference with a Show Ads toggle in settings.
